title: A worker's report maps each constraint of an operator-answered gate to the code and a probe, so a narrowing the answer names is not dropped
goal: The worker rules ask a worker whose item holds an answered gate to list each constraint the answer text names (such as 'in one option') with the code line and the probe that hold it, and the brief prints the answered gates' answers in full (SP-hlt2tdel: BG-t6xrawba's g1 answer said the unit-noun list is read in one option; the worker matched the joined question and options, named it only as a limit in its report, and the orchestrator sent it back)

run:
import sys, tempfile, json, subprocess, os
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_base, bl_dispatch
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", d], check=True)
bl_base.load_settings(d)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, bl_base.rel_dir()), exist_ok=True)
gate = {"id": "g1", "question": "which list does the rule read", "options": ["whole text", "one option"], "kind": "blocking", "class": "design", "answer": "one option only: the unit-noun list is read in a single option", "by": "operator"}
item = {"id": "ST-aaaaaaaa", "kind": "story", "title": "a rule", "status": "doing", "priority": "P3", "rank": 0, "goal": "the rule is applied", "checks": [{"run": ["true"]}], "touches": ["_tools/bl_authority.py"], "gates": [gate]}
open(os.path.join(d, bl_base.rel_dir(), "ST-aaaaaaaa.json"), "w").write(json.dumps(item))
bl = bl_base.Backlog(d)
bl_dispatch.rules_section = lambda bl, iid: ["x"]
t = bl_dispatch.compose_brief(bl, "ST-aaaaaaaa")
rules = t.split("## Fixed rules")[1].split("## Rules of the docs")[0].lower()
ok = "single option" in t and "answered gate" in rules and "constraint" in rules
print("answer in brief and rules map its constraints:", ok)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
